passages.provision_quote: The resolution is meant to secure the southern border by allowing local law enforcement officers to arrest those who cross the border illegally.
passages.note: News report of a Senate vote on HCR 2060, which concerns local law-enforcement arrest authority over illegal border crossing, not deportation of undocumented immigrants already present.
passages.actor_quote: Democratic Senator Brian Fernandez, who voted against it
passages.tally_quote: In a 16 to 13 vote, with one senator not voting

rows.reasoning: The only passage reports Fernandez's No vote on HCR 2060, the 'Secure the Border Act,' whose operative content is local law-enforcement arrest authority over illegal border crossing. That is a different dimension than how aggressively to deport undocumented immigrants already in the country, so it is adjacent and cannot establish a chair.
